sample_size_rationale: Dev tracer uses 20 DMX-aligned episodes across deep and generic categories with clarify/abstain/faq/negation branches. Sealed test uses 40 held-out episodes stratified by category and difficulty to target primary hard-constraint CI width near +/-0.08 at 95% bootstrap under the frozen catalog hash.
release_procedure: Freeze protocol + ready manifest catalog hash
Register sealed dev/test file and inputs-only hashes in SEAL_RECORD
Run deterministic conditions predict-only; lock prediction hash
Score once against frozen labels; write CHAIN_OF_CUSTODY
notes: Labels are colocated in JSONL for single-machine reproducibility. inputs_sha256 isolates turn text from labels for custody audits.
